findings.field: for i in old_static[files] loop, snapshot=Path(i[snapshot])
findings.description: The final package auditor unconditionally requires snapshot on every initial static file entry. The imported round57 snapshot-library entry intentionally has helper/sha256/scope but no snapshot key. Thus the frozen auditor raises KeyError before final acceptance even when the package is valid.

entry.scope: Read imported snapshot-library definitions and __main__guard; runpy(snapshot_library) does not run historical main.

findings.proposed_correction: Distinguish snapshotted round73 helpers from the explicit imported library entry; bind the library to its recorded exact path/hash without inventing a source snapshot, and retain the full original audit unchanged.
findings.acceptance: Focused execution of the actual static-input verification block accepts the declared imported library shape and rejects changed library bytes, missing current-round snapshot, and changed current-round snapshot.

limitations: Read-only static inspection; full publication helper not executed.
Independent library has no original snapshot, but its original path and SHA256 were recorded in the initial audit.
